producer_description.literal_text:
Extract only the latest user message, never earlier consent. Current phase: {{phase}}. Exact tagged-row grammar: k=KIND;c=0_OR_1;[optional key=value;]END. Rows separated by a single newline. No quotes, JSON, empty fields, extra separators or trailing newline. Required k and c. c=0 for unfinished answers or corrections, c=1 only complete. For unfinished payment/proposal/change/consent/hardship rows c=0, REQUIRED u=amount, date, both, or unknown: the component still unfinished, independently of any complete sibling. a and d contain ONLY completed components. u=unknown if unclear which changed. A complete date beside an unfinished amount requires u=amount; Mon... requires u=date. Complete rows c=1 omit u. Optional p=exact product ID or spoken type/label; a=plain positive decimal amount; d=verbatim exact date phrase (today, tomorrow, this/next weekday, YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, day month year); v=security answer (DOB verbatim date, phone exactly four digits); t=HH:MM. Values may contain only letters, numbers, spaces, underscore, period, slash, colon, hyphen. No escaping: if a value needs a delimiter, emit k=unknown;c=1;END. Unknown/duplicate keys forbidden. Kinds: agree callback change confirm deceased decline dispute hardship human paid plan proposal purpose question recipient refuse security stop third_party too_much unknown vague wrong_number. Recipient only explicit yes/thats me/speaking/own name; greeting is unknown. Security v must preserve numeric DOB as day/month/year. Proposal a/d only positive asserted payment terms, never negated or incidental dates. Partial amount/date retains its target. Agreement to an actual spoken offer is agree; clear unqualified yes after readback is confirm. Qualified yes with new terms is proposal; incomplete correction c=0. paid means current arrears already paid, historical closed/paid off is dispute; negated claims do not count. Hardship outranks plans/refusal but include any voluntary a/d. Human/plan/stop outrank incidental keywords. One row per distinct target; collective yes can use one unscoped agree/confirm only when it clearly covers all spoken offers/readback. Examples (literal valid outputs):
k=recipient;c=1;END
k=security;c=1;v=14 October 1980;END
k=security;c=1;v=1234;END
k=proposal;c=1;p=credit card;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=agree;c=1;p=personal loan;END
k=confirm;c=1;END
k=proposal;c=0;p=car loan;u=date;a=50;END
k=callback;c=1;d=tomorrow;t=15:00;END
k=proposal;c=1;p=credit card;a=120;d=next Friday;END
k=refuse;c=1;p=personal loan;END
k=paid;c=1;p=car loan;END ALWAYS emit a nonempty event for every latest reply. A bare complete four-digit reply in phone phase is security with v, never omit it. A complete birth date in dob phase is security with v. Every security event requires v. Incomplete date corrections use k=change;c=0 and d only if a complete date was spoken. One proposal plus too_much for the same product is allowed; do not put the rejected full amount into the proposal. Simple yes in readback phase is k=confirm;c=1;END, and yes in offer phase is k=agree;c=1;END. Never extract prior speech.
Unfinished examples (literal valid outputs):
k=change;c=0;u=date;END
k=proposal;c=0;u=amount;d=this Friday;END
k=change;c=0;u=amount;END
k=change;c=0;u=unknown;END
Only a newly complete explicit customer amount resolves u=amount; a later date-only answer leaves it unresolved. Never reuse an earlier superseded amount.

findings.summary: Weekday+ordinal and yearless d values are character-syntax valid but unsupported by literal advertised producer date forms. Direct injection repeats exact-day questions and closes service_error after five repeats (no_progress=4). ISO and explicit current-year day-month-year controls correctly offer 27 October, re-read, require later yes and prepare exact 540 promise. A normalized current-year bridge also passes, but violates the literal verbatim requirement for original Monday-the-26th speech and is not observed producer output.
findings.boundary: PUB-07 explicitly supplies Monday the 26th, so producer coverage must be addressed for end-to-end conformance; this witness does not establish what an actual extractor would emit.
findings.semantic_contract_ambiguity: Parenthesized date forms are advertised but not an explicit closed-list prohibition. Unsupported-form classification is literal advertised-form scope; actual producer output remains unobserved.

findings.summary: Faithful k=proposal;c=1;a=109.50;d=Friday produces required new readback and residual warning, then permits the exact corrected write only after later confirmation. The review expressly injects false confirm or false u=date rows, both violating producer semantics. With exact final-period raw, false confirm sets missing=unknown and remains blocked after Friday and yes, contradicting that part of the review path. Forced u=date invalidates only date and retains 365; later Friday and a clear yes to fresh 365 readback can route a write. A separately tested punctuation-omitted false-confirm variant reproduces the same drift. This demonstrates conditional stale-term drift, not actual ASR, hosted fault, or a write bypassing the later fresh readback.

findings.summary: Pinned source defaults are tr/tr, leyla, and Turkish firstMessage; actual export metadata identifies workflow and agent. All three existing A3 version-3 hosted text calls are bound to those IDs, begin with the required English bank/recording disclosure, faithfully extract the gardas partial-amount offer, and record 126 on 14 October. Call entity identity snapshots carry published version ID/number, but contain no active STT/TTS/firstMessage configuration snapshot. producer_conformance_method.transport_syntax: Checked independently from intended producer semantics; syntax validity alone does not establish faithful extraction.
producer_conformance_method.date_forms: Unsupported-form classification follows the literal advertised parenthesized form list. The prompt does not expressly say all other date phrases are forbidden, so this is a conservative contract reading rather than proof the model cannot emit ordinal/yearless dates. Under a broader reading of exact date phrase, the observed consumer coverage gap would apply to those forms; no actual extraction was run.
producer_conformance_method.normalization: Current-year bridge is expressly conditional because original producer says verbatim. No actual model normalization demonstrated.
producer_conformance_method.amount_semantics: Qualified yes with complete new amount is proposal; false confirm and false unfinished-date rows directly conflict with that rule.
producer_conformance_method.observations: Expected-observation matches include deliberately injected bad rows and do not establish policy pass rate.
